correctness.rationale: FO adjacency/equality quantifier rank three corresponds to three-move EF equivalence. For each path Pn with n>=7, the ordered-pair one-move adjacency-pattern type depends only on endpoint status and distances 1,2,>=3; pointed rank-two types stabilize, giving Pn≡3P7. Componentwise three-round EF composition truncates each P1,...,P7 multiplicity to at most three without increasing size. This covers all nonempty finite linear forests by 4^7−1=16,383 finite canonical cases. Complete two-vertex rank-one pattern type t_G(x,y), pointed rank-two union mask M_G(x), and rank-three sentence type S(G) are exact back-and-forth recursions. Independently enumerated all 16,383 signatures and obtained 160 distinct classes, sharp minimum-representative maximum order 23, unique sharp class 2P1⊔P2⊔P3⊔P4⊔P5⊔P7. The finite census is exhaustive only because the separate infinite-family normalization argument holds.
